nodes.summary: “Reimbursement percentage” shall mean the percentage of eligible expenses responsible by the Company.
bullets: “Reimbursement percentage” shall mean the percentage of eligible expenses responsible by the Company. The eligible expenses payable shall first be multiplied by the reimbursement percentage and then be capped by the maximum benefit limit (per visit or per day) as well as the maximum number of visit under each benefit. For example, for a benefit with HKD/MOP350 maximum limit per visit and 80% reimbursement percentage, the insured person incurs a claim of HKD/MOP 500 under the benefit. We shall pay HKD/MOP350 (HKD/MOP 500 X 80% = HKD/MOP 400, but capped at HKD/MOP 350), while the insured person pays the remaining HKD/MOP 150.

賠償百分率是指公司所承擔合資格費用的比例。合資格的賠償費用應先乘以賠償百分率，然後以最高保障額（按每次求診或每天計算）以及最高求診次數為上限。例如，一個保障的最高保障額為 HKD/MOP 350 及賠償百分率為 80%，而受保人在該保障下的索償金額為 HKD/MOP 500，我們將支付 HKD/MOP 350（HKD/MOP 500 X 80% = HKD/MOP 400，但以 HKD/MOP 350 為上限），而受保人則負擔剩餘的 HKD/MOP 150。
